title: Empirical Bayes Rebiasing
abstract: arXiv:2605.08069v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study methods for simultaneous analysis of many noisy and biased estimates, each paired with an even noisier estimate of its own bias. The analyst's goal is to construct short calibrated intervals for each parameter. The standard debiasing approach, which subtracts the bias estimate from each biased estimate, inflates variance and yields long intervals. In this paper, we propose an empirical Bayes rebiasing strategy that starts from the fully debiased estimates and learns from data how much bias to reintroduce by estimating the unknown bias distribution. We provide convergence rates for the coverage of our intervals when the bias distribution is estimated using nonparametric maximum likelihood. Furthermore, we demonstrate substantial precision gains in prediction-powered inference, including pairwise LLM win-rate evaluations, as well as for inference of direct genetic effects in family-based GWAS.

translated_abstract: 我们研究了对大量含噪且有偏的估计进行同时分析的方法，其中每个估计都配有一个比其本身噪声更大的偏差估计。分析者的目标是为每个参数构建短且校准良好的置信区间。标准的去偏方法是将偏差估计从每个有偏估计中减去，这会增大方差并导致区间变长。在本文中，我们提出了一种经验贝叶斯再偏置策略，该策略从完全去偏的估计出发，通过估计未知的偏差分布，从数据中学习应该重新引入多少偏差。当偏差分布采用非参数极大似然方法估计时，我们提供了区间覆盖率的收敛速度。此外，我们在预测驱动推断中展示了显著的精度提升，包括大语言模型的两两胜率评估，以及基于家系的全基因组关联分析（GWAS）中直接遗传效应的推断。
tldr: 提出经验贝叶斯再偏置策略，通过估计未知偏差分布从数据中学习应重新引入的偏差量，从而显著缩短校准置信区间，并在预测驱动推断（如大语言模型胜率评估）和家系GWAS直接遗传效应推断中取得显著精度提升。
en_tdlr: Proposes an empirical Bayes rebiasing strategy that learns from data how much bias to reintroduce by estimating the unknown bias distribution, yielding substantially shorter calibrated intervals with demonstrated precision gains in prediction-powered inference and family-based GWAS.
